recalibration_rule.pattern1_justification: Scenario calculation: candidate must extract numeric values from business narrative and compute. Combined reading-comprehension + calculation demand warrants Moderate-Easy/2.
recalibration_rule.pattern2_justification: Definitional with sophisticated distractors: plausible same-domain alternatives create discriminator challenge not reflected in Easy/1. Candidate must distinguish between closely related accounting concepts.

distribution_impact.note: Additional Easy and Moderate changes beyond the 124 direct recalibrations are due to re-serialization normalizing Difficulty fields from S713 JSON.stringify output.
